ground_truth.root_cause: Bridge manager fetches current global ticket price instead of frozen price for active drawing.
ground_truth.fix_description: Fetch ticket price from active drawing state instead of global ticketPrice.

prediction.overall_explanation: Reviewed JackpotBridgeManager and the provided Jackpot context for exploitable, permissionless attack paths (fund theft, unauthorized claims/transfers, state manipulation). The BridgeManager’s signature-gated flows (claimWinnings/claimTickets) correctly bind authorization to the EIP-712 signed payload and enforce ownership via the internal ticketOwner mapping. claimWinnings further relies on Jackpot.claimWinnings which burns the NFT tickets, preventing double-claims; replaying the same signature will fail once tickets are burned (or ticketOwner is deleted for claimTickets). The arbitrary bridge call is constrained by an exact USDC balance-delta check, preventing spending more than the claimed amount in a successful transaction. Reentrancy is mitigated on claimWinnings and buyTickets via ReentrancyGuardTransient; claimTickets is not nonReentrant but no concrete exploit was found because it requires valid signatures and state changes revert atomically on failure. No concrete, profit-motivated exploit that does not assume a compromised owner/admin or broken external dependencies was identified in the provided code.
